results.query: What is a beautiful state according to Sri Preethaji?
results.response_excerpt: You could be a beggar and live in a Beautiful State. You could be a couple and live in a Beautiful State. You could be a monk and live in a Beautiful State. For what is a Beautiful State? What is this transformed consciousness we're talking about? A Beautiful State is one in which you live free of the insistent conflicting inner chatter. A Beautiful State is one in which you are more present to life.

results.query: What does silence teach us about the mind?
results.response_excerpt: What do we mean by moving beyond the mind? What it is to be declutched from your mind. If you have observed at any point, there is an incessant thought noise, an inner chatter all the time. Imagine being free of that incessant thought noise, that incessant inner chatter that is there all the time. When you're walking, when you're working, when you're swimming, when you're with people or without people, there is an incessant noise. Imagine being free of that inner chatter, experiencing inner stillness, experiencing silence, that is to go beyond, or that is to declutch from the mind.

results.query: How does meditation change the way we live?
results.response_excerpt: How did our ancients live? They experienced their consciousness to be an infinite field of awareness that pervades the entire universe. They saw themselves and the world and all forms of life as a manifestation of the Divine. They sat down, closed their eyes and in the quietness of meditation found answers to life's problems. In every single breath they felt whole. In every single breath they felt connected. In every single breath they felt one. Shall we now breathe and meditate to expand our consciousness to experience the beauty of life?

results.query: You said consciousness is all that is. Can you say more about that?
results.response_excerpt: Krishnaji and I see that consciousness flows into us only in two forms. There is no third form. Consciousness either flows into us as I-Consciousness or as one consciousness. These two experiences of consciousness are unique to humanity. Because we are endowed with a brain, we are endowed with a nervous system that functions in a particular way. Our brain and a nervous system filters this all-pervasive field of consciousness and gives us two forms of experiences. I would say so think unlocks the mystical dimension of consciousness and opens you up to the limitlessness of your being.

results.query: gratitude ke baare mein kya batate hain?
results.response_excerpt: Gratitude is not about denying our efforts or disowning our achievements. We are not talking of a state of self-denial where you train yourself to never take pride in your successes or achievements. The gratitude we are speaking about is an expansion of awareness. This awareness happens to most of us in sacred moments. When we hold a newborn, we perhaps become grateful for the gift of life itself. Or when we recover from an illness, we feel truly grateful for every single breath we take with ease.
